data.body: **[P1] Publish content-addressed files atomically.** Writing directly to the final digest path can leave a truncated file if the invocation or filesystem write is interrupted. Every retry then sees `FileAlreadyExistsException`, rejects the differing content, and permanently wedges the durable execution. Write and flush a temporary sibling first, atomically move it to the final path, safely handle an already-published valid target, and clean up temporary files. Cover recovery from a partial target and concurrent writers.
